methodology.arrivals: Unchanged stress_compare.run_load; seed 20261006; paced open loop; scheduled-arrival latency; bounded queue 256; expiry 2s; connection timeout 8s
methodology.writes: 100 rows per synchronized append; mixed 5%, write 25%; 5% late timestamps; no identified receipt IDs in this service workload
methodology.ordering: Rotate variant order by one each round; fresh million-row store for every case
methodology.durability: No weakened synchronization or ACK policy. 0/2/8ms are existing explicit LiveOptions policies, not an engine change
methodology.limits: Shared Windows laptop, loopback JSON test bridge vs native reference interfaces, no affinity. Short sweeps and one 60s soak; not production qualification or universal ranking
methodology.serialization: No compilation or another heavy task overlaps a timed case. Scrubs, reopen, fixture creation, samples/report work outside load

cases.latency_population: successful operations only; loss/expiry/errors reported separately

host_telemetry.method: GetSystemTimes / GlobalMemoryStatusEx, 1 Hz; whole-host observations within timed arrival window; not disk latency or process attribution
